My reasoning:

I am 70, farmed this land 50 years. I never went to school but my hands know the soil. My 6.8 mu is small, so I must count every yuan. I will do like last year — what works, works.

I split my land. Cotton I put on 2 mu, the sandier corner where wheat does poor. The other 4.8 mu I do wheat then maize, same as always, same as my neighbors in the village.

For wheat, before sowing in October I spread compound fertilizer — one bag (50 jin, 25 kg) per mu, the 15-15-15 kind the dealer sells. Then in spring when wheat turns green I topdress urea, maybe half a bag per mu, about 20 jin. My neighbor Old Wang does the same. I water 3 times with my well — one before winter, one at jointing, one when grain fills. I spray 2 times for aphids and the yellow sickness. Last year I got about 450 kg from each mu, should be similar.

For maize after wheat, I plant right away in June, no plowing, just rotary till over the stubble. Same compound fertilizer, one bag per mu at sowing. When maize reaches my waist I put urea again, maybe more this time, 25 jin, because maize eats heavy. Two waterings, one spray for the borer worm. I get 500 kg per mu usually.

Cotton needs more work. I plow proper before planting, put compound fertilizer two bags on the 2 mu, plus some urea later. Cotton is thirsty — 3 waterings. And pests, always pests — I spray 5 times, bollworm and aphid, cannot skip or harvest is lost. I buy the improved seed from the town dealer, everyone does now. Maybe 250 kg seed cotton per mu.

I would rather put a bit extra fertilizer than watch my crop go yellow. Fertilizer is money but empty bags at harvest is worse.
